mapper.select: SELECT A.ENTRUST_ID entrustId,/*委托代码*/ A.FINPROD_ID finprodId,/*金融产品代码*/ C.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr,/*金融产品简称*/ C.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket,/*交易场所*/ C.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId,/*市场代码*/ A.PLEDGE_FACE_VALUE pledgeFaceValue,/*质押面值*/ A.Pledge_Number pledgeNumber,/*质押数量*/ A.PLEDGE_RATIO pledgeRatio,/*质押率*/ A.PLEDGE_AMT pledgeAmt/*质押金额*/ FROM ETR_PLEDGE A LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT C ON A.FINPROD_ID=C.FINPROD_ID WHERE A.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ETR_ENTRUST SET ENTRUST_STATUS = #{entrustStatus} WHERE ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}
mapper.select: select REAL_NAME from SYS_USER where USER_NAME = #{userId}
